articles.title: Pick-by-pick takes on Round 1 of the NFL draft: How prospects fit with their new teams
articles.summary: Here's our NFL Nation reporters' look at the biggest questions for each Round 1 pick and how every player fits with his new team.

articles.title: Rams take Simpson as likely Stafford successor
articles.summary: While the Rams selected quarterback Ty Simpson with the 13th pick in the NFL draft Thursday night, coach Matthew Stafford made it clear: "This is Matthew's team."

articles.title: Amid Brown buzz, Eagles trade up for WR Lemon
articles.summary: The Eagles made a trade with the division rival Cowboys on Thursday night, selecting USC wide receiver Makai Lemon with the No. 20 pick.

articles.title: Cowboys trade up for Downs, then pick Lawrence
articles.summary: After taking Ohio State safety Caleb Downs at No. 11 thanks to a trade with the Dolphins, the Cowboys selected UCF edge rusher Malachi Lawrence with the 23rd overall pick after moving down from No. 20 following a trade with the Eagles.

articles.title: Jets refuel, pick DE Bailey, TE Sadiq, WR Cooper
articles.summary: The Jets selected three players in the first round Thursday night -- DE David Bailey at No. 2, TE Kenyon Sadiq at 16 and WR Omar Cooper Jr. at No. 30.

articles.title: 'Ecstatic' Mendoza goes to Raiders with top pick
articles.summary: The Raiders made it official Thursday night at the NFL draft, taking former Indiana star QB Fernando Mendoza with the No. 1 pick.

articles.title: Chiefs move up to No. 6, use pick on CB Delane
articles.summary: The Chiefs moved up in the NFL draft Thursday night, acquiring the No. 6 pick from the Browns and using it to select LSU cornerback Mansoor Delane. Cleveland took Spencer Fano at No. 9.

articles.title: Vrabel: Confident in Pats during draft absence
articles.summary: Mike Vrabel said he is confident that the Patriots will have a successful draft during his absence Saturday, when he will start seeking counseling after multiple media outlets posted photos of the coach with former Athletic reporter Dianna Russini.

articles.title: Giants draft Reese at No. 5, then Mauigoa at 10
articles.summary: The New York Giants addressed both sides of the ball Thursday in the first round of the NFL draft, selecting Ohio State linebacker Arvell Reese with the fifth pick and then taking Miami offensive lineman Francis Mauigoa at No. 10.
